name: toolz-sliding-window
task: toolz.sliding_window returns the wrong windows: list(sliding_window(2, [1, 2, 3, 4])) should be [(1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4)]. Run `python -m pytest toolz/tests/test_itertoolz.py -q -k sliding_window` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: more-itertools-tail
task: more_itertools.tail raises ValueError for some inputs. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_recipes.py -q -k Tail` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: tabulate-padding
task: Left-aligned columns in tabulate output are one character too narrow, so table rows no longer line up with their separators. Run `python -m pytest test/test_output.py -q -x` to see a failure, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: humanize-naturalsize
task: humanize.naturalsize gives wrong results in its default decimal mode, for example naturalsize(3000000) should be '3.0 MB'. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_filesize.py -q` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
task: Some JMESPath built-in functions give wrong answers; the compliance suite fails. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_compliance.py -q -k functions` to see the failures, find the bug in the library, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests or the compliance JSON files.

name: click-intrange-clamp
task: click.IntRange with clamp=True and an open bound clamps to the wrong side: IntRange(0, min_open=True, clamp=True) converts '0' to -1 but should give 1. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_types/test_IntRange.py -q` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: jinja-batch-filter
task: The jinja2 `batch` filter returns rows with one item too many. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_filters.py -q -k batch` to see the failure, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: packaging-canonicalize
task: packaging.utils.canonicalize_name no longer normalizes some names the way PEP 503 requires; for example canonicalize_name('oslo.concurrency') should be 'oslo-concurrency'. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_utils.py -q -k canonicalize_name` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: pyparsing-lineno
task: pyparsing reports line numbers that are off by one: the first line of a string is reported as line 0. Run `python -m pytest tests/test_unit.py -q -x` to see a failure, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.

name: tomli-unicode-escape
task: tomli parses \uXXXX escapes in basic strings incorrectly, so documents with such escapes fail to load or load with wrong text. Run `python -m pytest tests -q` to see the failures, fix the library code, and make the tests pass. Do not modify tests.
